description: Patient age at notebook run date
Postural instability symptom flag at diagnosis
Whether dopaminergic therapy has been started

feature_name: Freezing of gait in past 36 months
value_encoding_or_scale: 1 = Rare freezing (may have start hesitation); 2 = Occasional freezing when walking; 3 = Frequent freezing with occasional falls; 4 = Frequent falls from freezing; 0 may appear after imputation

description: GDS-15 total depression score after item reversals
value_encoding_or_scale: Sum of 15 binary items; higher = more depressive burden

description: Derived mobility summary based on 7 daily activity items: getting on and off the toilet; stepping up and down curbs; getting in and out of a car; getting out of bed into a chair; running errands and shopping; getting off the floor without help; and walking at least 15 minutes
value_encoding_or_scale: Each mobility item is transformed with Gaussian weights: 0=Fully able->0.18; 1=Mostly able->0.53; 2=Moderate difficulty->0.91; 3=Moderate difficulty->0.91; 4=Mostly unable->0.53; 5=Fully unable->0.18; final feature is the sum across 7 items

description: Daytime sleepiness from MDS-UPDRS Part I questionnaire
value_encoding_or_scale: 0 = Normal (no daytime sleepiness); 1 = Slight (can resist and stay awake); 2 = Mild (sometimes fall asleep when alone/relaxing); 3 = Moderate (sometimes fall asleep when should not e.g. while eating); 4 = Severe (often fall asleep when should not)

description: Urinary problems from MDS-UPDRS Part I questionnaire
value_encoding_or_scale: 0 = Normal (no urine control problems); 1 = Slight (urinate often/urgently no daily activity impact); 2 = Mild (some difficulties with daily activities no accidents); 3 = Moderate (a lot of difficulties including urine accidents); 4 = Severe (cannot control urine use protective garment or bladder tube)

description: Clinician-rated gait impairment from MDS-UPDRS Part III
value_encoding_or_scale: 0 = Normal (no problems); 1 = Slight (independent walking with minor impairment); 2 = Mild (independent walking with substantial impairment); 3 = Moderate (requires walking aid but not a person); 4 = Severe (cannot walk without another person's assistance); 101 = unable to rate

description: Clinician-rated postural stability from MDS-UPDRS Part III
value_encoding_or_scale: 0 = Normal (recovers with 1-2 steps); 1 = Slight (3-5 steps recovers unaided); 2 = Mild (>5 steps recovers unaided); 3 = Moderate (stands safely but falls if not caught by examiner); 4 = Severe (very unstable loses balance spontaneously); 101 = unable to rate

0 = Asymptomatic; 1 = Unilateral involvement only; 2 = Bilateral involvement without balance impairment; 3 = Mild-moderate with postural instability but physically independent; 4 = Severe disability but can walk/stand unassisted; 5 = Wheelchair bound or bedridden unless aided; 101 = unable to rate

description: MDS-UPDRS Part III total motor examination score (sum of 33 items)
